model.title: EARLY Act Reauthorization of 2025
model.meta: Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions Committee · Sen. Amy Klobuchar (D-MN)

summary.text: The bill would reauthorize federal programs through fiscal year 2031 that aim to educate young women about breast health and cancer prevention, support research on breast cancer in younger women, and provide grants for resources and services to young women with breast cancer or precancerous conditions. These programs are run by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.
